::: {id="msg-en"}

## Oops!

The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

**Check out other sections of the site:**

> [Data Projects](/en/projects/)  
> [Data Visualization Tutorials](/en/tutorials/)  
> [Go to Home](/)

:::



::: {#msg-zh style="display:none"}

## 哎呀！

您访问的页面不存在或已被移动。

**浏览网站的其他内容：**

> [数据项目](/zh/projects/)  
> [数据可视化教程](/zh/tutorials/)  
> [返回首页](/zh/)

:::



<script>
(function () {
    if (/\/(zh)(\/|$)/.test(window.location.pathname)) {
        document.getElementById('msg-en').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('msg-zh').style.display = '';
        document.title = '404 页面未找到';
        const h1 = document.querySelector('h1.title');
        if (h1) h1.textContent = '404 页面未找到';

        // giscus is embedded with a static build-time language (en); since this
        // page toggles en/zh client-side, override it once giscus is ready.
        // The iframe's presence in the DOM doesn't mean its cross-origin app has
        // mounted yet, so a postMessage sent right away is silently dropped;
        // wait for giscus's own readiness message instead.
        // https://github.com/giscus/giscus/blob/main/ADVANCED-USAGE.md#isetconfigmessage
        window.addEventListener('message', function onGiscusReady(event) {
            if (event.origin !== 'https://giscus.app') return;
            if (!(event.data?.giscus)) return;
            window.removeEventListener('message', onGiscusReady);
            const iframe = document.querySelector('iframe.giscus-frame');
            if (!iframe) return;
            iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ giscus: { setConfig: { lang: 'zh-CN' } } }, 'https://giscus.app');
        });
    }
})();
</script>
